question: What is the scope of the reality to be meditated upon in every place?
premises: Meditation is to be performed in place after place.
The object of meditation extends from Shiva down to Avici.
inference: One should meditate in every place on that reality which extends from Shiva down to Avici.
plain_english: Having meditated in place after place on that which extends from Shiva down to Avici.
